digest.component_or_area: code-review workflow, finding carry-forward across revisions
propositions: Code-review findings raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on the next are lost to consumers because sidecar payloads are keyed by (change_id, revision) and the code-review artifact is emitted once per revision, causing non-deterministic recall

Finding eligibility is restricted to surfaced items with non-empty evidence; classification by region state (still-present / addressed / withdrawn) is computed once per finding in a new carry_forward module, not in merge_findings which sees only lists

A still-present item (cited file hash unchanged or region unresolvable) is injected into fresh Pass-1 output; an addressed item (file changed) or withdrawn item (already carried) is not re-carried, terminating carry at one patchset

Standing items carry three new attributes (origin_revision, origin_decision, state) and origin_decision is stamped from the prior surfaced bucket (blocking→block, advisory→advisory) with advisory as fallback, never inventing a blocking posture
The posture clamp in code_review_decide prevents a carried finding from raising decision beyond its origin_decision, protecting against criterion changes between patchsets
